description: Use when a user asks about Coast FIRE, e.g. "what is my Coast FIRE number at 30?" or "can I stop saving for retirement and let it grow?". FIRE number (yearly spending / withdrawal rate) and Coast FIRE number: what you need invested now so growth alone reaches your FIRE number by retirement age. Add current savings and a monthly contribution to see the gap and the age you reach Coast FIRE. Uses a real (after inflation) return, 7% by default; same math as the Compound Mint Coast FIRE calculator.

annual_return.description: Real yearly return percent after inflation (default 7).

annual_spending.description: Yearly spending in retirement in today's USD (or send fire_number).

fire_number.description: Total needed to retire in USD (instead of annual_spending).

name: calculate_coast_fire
title: Coast FIRE calculator
